entry_item.definition: T. ma. In names and epithets eke indicates often simply the feminine gender or sex which native writers sometimes misinterpreted as "mother", so that it is not always possible to ascertain in which sense it is used, e. g. Dar –a eke . "Mother" Tara who is in later Buddhist schools considered to be the mother of all the Bus.

example.definition: T. rgyal yum. Mother of the conqueror, i. e. the Buddha.
